subject: tablecodec, executor: fix non unqiue global index work with union scan (#61089)
summary: Reviewed diff vs first parent, focusing on `pkg/tablecodec/tablecodec.go` and `pkg/executor/mem_reader.go`. Change correctly decodes `PartitionID` from global index values when the handle is encoded in the index key (non-unique / unique-with-NULL cases) and returns a `kv.PartitionHandle`; union-scan’s YEAR-common-handle conversion now preserves that partition wrapper. Partition-handle consumers (e.g. `tablecodec.EncodeRecordKey` and executor partition-handle logic) already support this shape, and I found no remaining Blocker/High correctness/consistency/compatibility risks in the touched planner/executor/tablecodec behavior.
